wallet.description: Your PUBLIC Solana address: the wallet watched and the fee payer of the prepared transaction. Never a key.

keep_sol.description: SOL that stays in the wallet after a swap.

drop_pct.description: Prepare a swap when SOL is at least this many percent below the reference price.

reference_price_usd.description: The price a drop is measured from. Null = the highest price this agent has seen.

venue.description: sato = Sato Route, the labelled default, with a no-Sato-fee Jupiter quote alongside; direct = Jupiter only, no Sato call.
